title: Letter Treasure Hunt
shareTitle: Letter Treasure Hunt — Well Done! Phonics Treasure Island
description: Scroll through A–Z papercraft letter islands, then find three familiar objects that begin with the selected sound. A gentle phonics adventure for ages 2–5.
learningGoals: Hear and repeat beginning letter sounds
Connect uppercase letters with familiar object names
Build confidence through touch, feedback, and repetition
interactionModel: scroll a three-island A–Z sea map, then tap three spatially arranged matches after a spoken letter prompt
feedbackModel: Correct finds bounce into a letter token with phonics praise; reviewed A/B/C layered scenes include a gentle chest retry cue; progress remains visible and the next island is one tap away.
